name: Metronome Synth USD
oneLiner: msUSD is Metronome's crypto-backed synth; its July 2026 shortfall was reported resolved in September, while the synth swap remains closed.
collateral: USDC, DAI, ETH, WBTC, sfrxETH, and Vesper Finance yield-bearing tokens (vaUSDC, vaETH, vaSTETH, vaRETH, vaCBETH); FRAX and vaFRAX accepted but currently inactive; collateral factors range 75 to 85%
pegMechanism: Collateralized CDP: users deposit crypto collateral to mint msUSD and repay debt to reclaim collateral, with no direct holder redemption of collateral. Metronome's September 16, 2026 recovery update reports that treasury-funded buybacks and an $8 million USDC loan closed the July underbacking. The synth swap remains closed indefinitely; treasury buybacks and MetBasis liquidity support peg recovery.

notices.title: Primary swap closed and persistent ~20% discount
notices.message: Metronome's synth swap stays closed indefinitely with no independent reserve reconciliation, and msUSD has traded roughly 20% below $1 through November 2026. A July 30, 2026 post-mortem disclosed about 4.57M unbacked msUSD from a Chainlink latency flaw; Metronome reported closing the shortfall on September 16 via buybacks and an $8M USDC loan, without reopening primary swaps.
